data.question_quote: Do you think, without the Treasury movements turning into tailwinds, the UK NIM would still manage to creep up?
data.answer_quote: I would say yes, because they are modest Treasury tailwinds. We did talk before about expecting more product compression earlier in the year than later, and that part of the seasonal movement that we see in deposits around Q1.
